scope: Retrospective matched development diagnostics; no independent-test claim

adaptation.mixture_coordinate: inverse TTC; bounded emitted TTC at 60 seconds
adaptation.fallback: same-replay original output whenever geometric estimate is unavailable
adaptation.primary: raw signed MAE on common geometry support; full-coverage fallback MAE also mandatory

fusion.population: 460 corrected transfer queries from 32 historically inspected recordings
fusion.interpretation: Readout comparisons conditional on the frozen final producers and their temporal support; not equal-capacity retraining or a latent-fusion test

statistics.interval: paired percentile 95%; descriptive and conditional on the inspected cohort

selection: None: all declared arms and populations are reported
independent_data: User reports no known unused recordings; public compatibility audit required
